paper.title_en: A simple solvable $Z_N$ Hamiltonian in any dimension
paper.abstract_en: We construct local $Z_N$ clock Hamiltonians from Baxter-Fendley chains coupled according to an arbitrary finite oriented simple transverse graph. Bounded edge lengths and vertex degrees give finite-range multispin interactions, with $2d$-site bulk terms on a $d$-dimensional rectangular lattice. For open longitudinal boundaries, an explicit nonlocal unitary transformation decouples the chains and gives a free parafermion spectrum. On rectangular lattices this holds for any combination of open and periodic transverse boundaries. For periodic longitudinal boundaries, neighbouring chain charges fix the closing-bond twists. In each joint charge sector, the energies are sums of the corresponding twisted periodic-chain energies. As an example, we construct a three-dimensional array of chains perpendicular to a Penrose rhombus tiling.
